title: Independent cleanups run in reverse registration order and a panic in one does not stop the others.

divergences.reason: Go reports cleanup failures to the caller: Close/Wait accumulate them and return a joined error, so a panicking cleanup is observable. The reference logs each cleanup failure and resolves dispose() successfully, so its root disposer reports ok. Go's stricter surface is deliberate - a caller that cannot observe a failed cleanup cannot decide whether teardown was safe - and it is asserted by TestChildrenDisposedAndCleanupContinuesAfterPanic. Both runtimes still run every remaining cleanup exactly once, and the trace records the same cleanup order and final state.
